name: STS GetSessionToken Abuse
description: STS GetSessionToken turns a long-term access key (and optional MFA) into a temporary session. Attackers use it to get credentials that last hours and look like a normal CLI session. It is not the same as GetFederationToken, which is meant for federated users. A human using the CLI may call this legitimately. A key that never used MFA suddenly minting long sessions from a new IP is the suspicious pattern. Rotate the long-term key if the session was not expected.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
